clue.text: Enough nice stuff, I fancy

parts.note: anagram fodder, 10 letters

explanation.walkthrough: 'I fancy' reads as the speaker's opinion; the I is actually the last letter of the fodder and 'fancy' is the instruction.

clue.text: Error in IT caught by quiet past A-level student?

explanation.definitionFit: A sixth-former is a pupil in the last two years of a British secondary school, usually studying for A-level exams.

clue.text: Criminal following Musk?

parts.note: f. is the abbreviation for following, as in 'p. 12 f.'
Elon Musk

clue.text: Unwise making changes to dine with Trump

parts.note: anagram fodder

clue.text: Detach unit very tardily

late = tardily, as in 'arrived late'

clue.text: In hospital room, tuck into bay, say, prior to round for protection

clue.text: Bringing about locomotive on European circuit

clue.text: Put flesh on the bones of former god, dread periodically slipping away

Pan, the Greek god of the wild
